settings.heading: Breathing better shouldn’t be complicated.
settings.lead: Noctara is a magnetic nasal strip that opens your nose from the sides — so you can sleep, train and focus with more air.
settings.story:
Paper strips peeled off by midnight. Nose cones felt wrong. So we went looking for something simpler.

Noctara uses two small magnets and a reusable band to gently lift your nostrils open. Stick on the tabs, snap the band on, and breathe.

Every order ships free with tracking and is backed by our 30-night money-back guarantee.
